content:
This is a freight-forwarding / Parcel Express dataset; a booking is a shipment order.
- First-Time-Right (FTR) = first_time_right=true (no manual correction). Report as percentage via avg(first_time_right::int).
- Automation / electronic-integration share = share with channel IN ('API','EDI') (is_electronic=true); EMAIL, PORTAL, FAX_OCR are manual.
- Amendment rate = share with amendment_count>0. No-show = no_show=true.
- Lane = origin_hub-destination_hub. Capacity utilization = booked_capacity/available_capacity. Booking velocity = lead_time_days.
- Modes AIR/OCEAN/ROAD. Time grains: booking_month/booking_week/booking_date. Prefer gold marts; silver.bookings_clean for drill-down.

question: Top lanes by volume
sql: SELECT lane, sum(bookings) AS bookings FROM dsv.gold.lane_concentration GROUP BY lane ORDER BY bookings DESC LIMIT 10

question: FTR by channel
sql: SELECT channel, round(avg(first_time_right::int),4) AS ftr_rate, count(*) AS bookings FROM dsv.silver.bookings_clean GROUP BY channel ORDER BY ftr_rate DESC
